ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives.
   D. Say Selected Hadith Unity Avoidance of ill motives has no place in daily life.

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)

   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Cheating in exams
